hero.title: Every access is a 0 or a 1. We make it the right one.
hero.description: Qubital is an identity & access management consultancy. We help organisations control who and what can access their systems, from privileged accounts and identity governance to customer, workforce and AI agent identities.

home.statement: Our name comes from the qubit, which can be 0 and 1 at the same time. Access can't. Every login, every permission, every action of an AI agent ends in one decision: granted or denied. We make sure each one is right.

practice.title: Access, decided in seconds.
practice.description: A new colleague needs access. Policy checks run on their own, the manager approves with one click, and everything is logged for the audit.

pam.title: Privileged Access Management (PAM)
pam.short: Secure, control and monitor the accounts with the most powerful rights.
pam.description: Privileged accounts are the top target in almost every attack. We help you discover them, vault their credentials, enforce just-in-time access and record sessions, so admin rights are only used when needed and always traceable.

iga.title: Identity Governance & Administration (IGA)
iga.short: Everyone has exactly the access they need, and you can prove it.
iga.description: We automate the identity lifecycle from joiner to leaver, build role models that fit your organisation, and set up access reviews and reporting that satisfy auditors without overloading your managers.

ciam.title: Customer Identity (CIAM)
ciam.short: Seamless, secure sign-in experiences your customers trust.
ciam.description: Registration, login and consent shape the first impression of your digital products. We design customer identity that is frictionless for users, resilient against account takeover and compliant with GDPR.

wiam.title: Workforce Identity (WIAM)
wiam.short: One secure identity for every employee, on every app and device.
wiam.description: We give your workforce single sign-on, strong multi-factor authentication and conditional access, connecting cloud and on-premises applications into one consistent identity layer built on Zero Trust.

ai.title: AI & Agentic Identity Security
ai.short: Control what AI agents and machine identities can see and do.
ai.description: AI agents, bots and service accounts increasingly act on behalf of your people, often with broad, unmonitored access. We bring them under identity governance: clear ownership, tightly scoped permissions, short-lived credentials and full auditability.

page.title: Identity security. Done right.
page.description: Five specialised areas covering every identity in your organisation: administrators, employees, customers and AI agents.

items.q: Do you work with small and mid-sized companies?
items.a: Absolutely. Identity security matters at every size. We scale our approach, from a focused assessment to a full programme, to your organisation and budget.

items.q: We are affected by NIS2 or DORA. Can you help?
items.a: Yes. Identity and access controls are central to NIS2, DORA and ISO 27001. We assess where you stand, close the gaps and help you produce the evidence auditors ask for.

items.q: Can you operate our identity platform after go-live?
items.a: Yes. With our managed services we take care of operations, updates, access reviews and support, with clear SLAs.

items.q: How much does a project cost?
items.a: It depends on scope. After a free initial conversation we send you a transparent proposal with fixed prices or clear daily rates, with no hidden costs.

hero.title: Named after the qubit. Built on clarity.
hero.description: Qubital was founded in Germany with a clear focus: identity is the new security perimeter, and it deserves specialists.

story.title: Why Qubital?
paragraphs: A classical bit is either 0 or 1. A qubit, the building block of quantum computers, can be both at once until it is measured. It holds every possibility at the same time.

That is how we approach a project. Before we commit to a solution, we keep the options open, listen carefully and explore what is possible. When the picture is clear, we decide and build with precision.
Qubital combines qubit and digital. In identity security that balance is everything: access has to be easy enough for people to do their work, and strict enough to keep attackers out.

hero.title: Complex in, clear out.
hero.description: Every project follows a proven path. You always know where we stand, what comes next and what it costs.

items.title: Discover
items.text: We map your identities, accounts, roles and access paths, human and machine, and assess them against your risks and regulatory requirements such as NIS2, DORA and ISO 27001.

items.title: Design
items.text: We design the target picture together: identity architecture, role and policy model, timeline and budget. You get a concrete plan, not a 100-page slide deck.

items.title: Build
items.text: We implement in short sprints with regular demos: connecting applications, migrating accounts and automating lifecycle processes. You see progress every two weeks and can steer at any time.

items.title: Evolve
items.text: Go-live is only the beginning. We operate and evolve your identity platform, run regular access reviews and train your team, so knowledge stays in your company.

items.title: Transparent pricing
items.text: Fixed prices or clear daily rates. You know the cost before we start.

items.title: Open standards
items.text: SAML, OpenID Connect and SCIM instead of lock-in. Your configurations, data and documentation belong to you.

items.title: Least privilege by default
items.text: Every design starts at 0: no access by default, only what is needed, for as long as it is needed.

items.title: Knowledge transfer
items.text: We document everything and train your team, so you stay independent.

sections.heading: 1. Controller
body: The controller responsible for data processing on this website is:
Qubital Systems GmbH, Herzogenaurach, Bavaria, Germany

sections.heading: 2. Hosting
body: This website is hosted by Vercel Inc., 440 N Barranca Ave #4133, Covina, CA 91723, USA. When you visit the website, the hosting provider processes technical data such as your IP address and the date and time of access in server log files. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR; our legitimate interest is the secure and reliable provision of the website. Transfers to the USA are based on the European Commission's standard contractual clauses or an adequacy decision such as the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework.

sections.heading: 3. Contact form and email
body: If you contact us via the contact form or by email, we process the data you provide (name, email address, organisation, area of interest and message) to answer your inquiry. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR where your inquiry relates to a contract, and otherwise Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR. Email delivery is handled by Resend, acting as our processor under Art. 28 GDPR. We delete the data once it is no longer needed, unless statutory retention obligations apply.

sections.heading: 4. Analytics
body: For product analytics we use PostHog, hosted in the EU and acting as our processor under Art. 28 GDPR. PostHog is configured to store no cookies or other identifiers in your browser and to respect the Do Not Track signal. The resulting statistics are pseudonymous and are not used to identify you. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR; our legitimate interest is understanding how the website is used in order to improve it.

sections.heading: 5. Cookies and local storage
body: This website uses no tracking or marketing cookies. It sets one technically necessary cookie (NEXT_LOCALE) to remember your language, and stores your chosen colour theme (light or dark) in your browser's local storage. Neither leaves your device for tracking purposes. The legal basis is § 25 (2) TDDDG.

sections.heading: 6. Fonts
body: All fonts are served from our own server. No connection to external font providers (such as Google) is made when you visit the website.

sections.heading: 7. Your rights
body: You have the right to access (Art. 15 GDPR), rectification (Art. 16), erasure (Art. 17), restriction of processing (Art. 18), data portability (Art. 20) and objection (Art. 21). To exercise these rights, contact us at contact@qubital.eu. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority, for example the Bavarian State Office for Data Protection Supervision (BayLDA).

sections.heading: 8. Changes
body: We may update this privacy policy to reflect changes in legal requirements or our services. The current version is always available on this page.
